title: Deterministic L∞ certification on CIFAR-10 at ε = 8/255, 2018–2024
subtitle: Certified and clean accuracy of certifiably trained CIFAR-10 models. Bound propagation plateaus near 35%; a Lipschitz network with generated data reaches 42%.
